title: Repository test suite governance
purpose: Record discovery-only test-suite standards and pre-UI test gates without adding tests, changing commands, or claiming readiness.

authorityBoundary.notes: This artifact closes planning criteria only. USF-960 remains open for actual failing-test resolution.

baselineBlocker.reason: Actual failing-test resolution requires implementation or test fixes and is excluded from discovery-only closure.

unitTestStandardDesign.title: Unit test standard
guidance: Fast semantic units remain close to package or capability ownership.
Unit tests must not replace contract, integration, proof, or validator tests.
unitTestStandardDesign.assuranceImpact: The design improves test ownership, selection, or proof value while preserving existing validation, proof, evidence, and non-claims.
unitTestStandardDesign.validationProofExpectation: Future implementation must run affected tests or fuller gates on ambiguity and must preserve planted-defect, fixture, evidence, command, provider, and environment boundaries where applicable.

validatorSelftestStandardDesign.title: Validator selftest standard
guidance: Validator selftests and planted defects remain required for validator changes.
Selftests must fail closed on invalid JSON, unknown controlled values, stale evidence, and omitted path classes.
validatorSelftestStandardDesign.assuranceImpact: The design improves test ownership, selection, or proof value while preserving existing validation, proof, evidence, and non-claims.
validatorSelftestStandardDesign.validationProofExpectation: Future implementation must run affected tests or fuller gates on ambiguity and must preserve planted-defect, fixture, evidence, command, provider, and environment boundaries where applicable.

integrationTestStandardDesign.title: Integration test standard
guidance: Integration tests cover cross-package, app, adapter, provider, and persistence boundaries.
Integration scope must declare services, fixtures, provider mode, environment, and evidence expectations.
integrationTestStandardDesign.assuranceImpact: The design improves test ownership, selection, or proof value while preserving existing validation, proof, evidence, and non-claims.
integrationTestStandardDesign.validationProofExpectation: Future implementation must run affected tests or fuller gates on ambiguity and must preserve planted-defect, fixture, evidence, command, provider, and environment boundaries where applicable.

composeIntegrationTestStandardDesign.title: Compose integration test standard
guidance: Compose integration tests are required for service-backed or provider-backed local proof where in-memory proof is insufficient.
Compose tests must preserve healthcheck, teardown, artifact, and generated-report boundaries.
composeIntegrationTestStandardDesign.assuranceImpact: The design improves test ownership, selection, or proof value while preserving existing validation, proof, evidence, and non-claims.
composeIntegrationTestStandardDesign.validationProofExpectation: Future implementation must run affected tests or fuller gates on ambiguity and must preserve planted-defect, fixture, evidence, command, provider, and environment boundaries where applicable.

proofEvidenceRegressionTestStandardDesig.title: Proof/evidence regression test standard
guidance: Proof and evidence regression tests protect evidence envelopes, freshness, provider/environment separation, and generated-report non-authority.
Regression tests must not treat generated reports as raw evidence.
proofEvidenceRegressionTestStandardDesig.assuranceImpact: The design improves test ownership, selection, or proof value while preserving existing validation, proof, evidence, and non-claims.
proofEvidenceRegressionTestStandardDesig.validationProofExpectation: Future implementation must run affected tests or fuller gates on ambiguity and must preserve planted-defect, fixture, evidence, command, provider, and environment boundaries where applicable.

snapshotGoldenFilePolicyDesign.title: Snapshot and golden-file policy
guidance: Snapshot or golden files are allowed only with source authority, update owner, diff review, and stale-output controls.
Generated snapshots need source manifests and must not become semantic authority.
snapshotGoldenFilePolicyDesign.assuranceImpact: The design improves test ownership, selection, or proof value while preserving existing validation, proof, evidence, and non-claims.
snapshotGoldenFilePolicyDesign.validationProofExpectation: Future implementation must run affected tests or fuller gates on ambiguity and must preserve planted-defect, fixture, evidence, command, provider, and environment boundaries where applicable.

fixtureLifecyclePolicyDesign.title: Fixture lifecycle policy
guidance: Fixtures need owner, source/generated classification, invalidation inputs, and resolution rules.
Fixture movement requires command and reference validation.
fixtureLifecyclePolicyDesign.assuranceImpact: The design improves test ownership, selection, or proof value while preserving existing validation, proof, evidence, and non-claims.
fixtureLifecyclePolicyDesign.validationProofExpectation: Future implementation must run affected tests or fuller gates on ambiguity and must preserve planted-defect, fixture, evidence, command, provider, and environment boundaries where applicable.

testDataGenerationPolicyDesign.title: Test data generation policy
guidance: Generated test data must be deterministic or record bounded non-determinism.
Generated data must preserve provider mode, environment, privacy, and evidence non-claims.
testDataGenerationPolicyDesign.assuranceImpact: The design improves test ownership, selection, or proof value while preserving existing validation, proof, evidence, and non-claims.
testDataGenerationPolicyDesign.validationProofExpectation: Future implementation must run affected tests or fuller gates on ambiguity and must preserve planted-defect, fixture, evidence, command, provider, and environment boundaries where applicable.

testShardingParallelisationDesign.title: Test sharding and parallelisation
guidance: Sharding and parallelisation require isolated resources, deterministic output paths, and before-after result equivalence.
Unknown shared state falls back to serial or fuller validation.
testShardingParallelisationDesign.assuranceImpact: The design improves test ownership, selection, or proof value while preserving existing validation, proof, evidence, and non-claims.
testShardingParallelisationDesign.validationProofExpectation: Future implementation must run affected tests or fuller gates on ambiguity and must preserve planted-defect, fixture, evidence, command, provider, and environment boundaries where applicable.

testFlakePolicyDesign.title: Test flake detection and quarantine policy
guidance: Flake detection records repeatability, seed, environment, provider mode, timing, and affected tests.
Quarantine does not convert a required gate to pass; owner review and rollback are required.
testFlakePolicyDesign.assuranceImpact: The design improves test ownership, selection, or proof value while preserving existing validation, proof, evidence, and non-claims.
testFlakePolicyDesign.validationProofExpectation: Future implementation must run affected tests or fuller gates on ambiguity and must preserve planted-defect, fixture, evidence, command, provider, and environment boundaries where applicable.

testTimingReportDesign.title: Test timing report
guidance: Timing reports should record command, scope, environment, cache state, duration, and failure status.
Timing data is performance evidence only and not readiness evidence.
testTimingReportDesign.assuranceImpact: The design improves test ownership, selection, or proof value while preserving existing validation, proof, evidence, and non-claims.
testTimingReportDesign.validationProofExpectation: Future implementation must run affected tests or fuller gates on ambiguity and must preserve planted-defect, fixture, evidence, command, provider, and environment boundaries where applicable.

affectedTestSelectionDesign.title: Affected-test selection
guidance: Affected-test selection requires a path-to-test ownership map, dependency graph, source hashes, and excluded path-class proof.
Unknown ownership falls back to broader test gates.
affectedTestSelectionDesign.assuranceImpact: The design improves test ownership, selection, or proof value while preserving existing validation, proof, evidence, and non-claims.
affectedTestSelectionDesign.validationProofExpectation: Future implementation must run affected tests or fuller gates on ambiguity and must preserve planted-defect, fixture, evidence, command, provider, and environment boundaries where applicable.

mandatoryTestSelectionDesign.title: Mandatory-test selection per change type
guidance: Change classes map to minimum required test suites and proof gates.
UI, schema, validator, runtime, evidence, provider, and command-surface changes have different required gates.
mandatoryTestSelectionDesign.assuranceImpact: The design improves test ownership, selection, or proof value while preserving existing validation, proof, evidence, and non-claims.
mandatoryTestSelectionDesign.validationProofExpectation: Future implementation must run affected tests or fuller gates on ambiguity and must preserve planted-defect, fixture, evidence, command, provider, and environment boundaries where applicable.

mutationNegativeControlDesign.title: Mutation or negative-control testing opportunities
guidance: Mutation and negative controls should target high-risk false negatives before broad mutation tooling.
Negative controls supplement planted defects and must have deterministic budgets.
mutationNegativeControlDesign.assuranceImpact: The design improves test ownership, selection, or proof value while preserving existing validation, proof, evidence, and non-claims.
mutationNegativeControlDesign.validationProofExpectation: Future implementation must run affected tests or fuller gates on ambiguity and must preserve planted-defect, fixture, evidence, command, provider, and environment boundaries where applicable.

coverageThresholdDesign.title: Coverage reporting and meaningful thresholds
guidance: Coverage thresholds must be meaningful by risk and semantic obligation, not a single vanity percentage.
Coverage reports must distinguish measured coverage from proof or semantic completeness.
coverageThresholdDesign.assuranceImpact: The design improves test ownership, selection, or proof value while preserving existing validation, proof, evidence, and non-claims.
coverageThresholdDesign.validationProofExpectation: Future implementation must run affected tests or fuller gates on ambiguity and must preserve planted-defect, fixture, evidence, command, provider, and environment boundaries where applicable.

coverageTheatreAvoidanceDesign.title: Avoiding coverage theatre
guidance: Coverage should protect authority-linked obligations and high-risk behaviour rather than inflate pass metrics.
Uncovered critical semantics are more important than high aggregate coverage percentages.
coverageTheatreAvoidanceDesign.assuranceImpact: The design improves test ownership, selection, or proof value while preserving existing validation, proof, evidence, and non-claims.
coverageTheatreAvoidanceDesign.validationProofExpectation: Future implementation must run affected tests or fuller gates on ambiguity and must preserve planted-defect, fixture, evidence, command, provider, and environment boundaries where applicable.

preUiRequiredTestsGateDesign.title: Tests required before UI work begins
guidance: Before UI work, required tests include unit, integration, contract, generated-client conformance, validator selftests, proof/evidence regression, app-surface semantic tests, and environment/proof routing checks.
Optional tests include property, mutation, browser/mobile, screenshot, and accessibility tests once scope and owner are defined.
preUiRequiredTestsGateDesign.assuranceImpact: The design improves test ownership, selection, or proof value while preserving existing validation, proof, evidence, and non-claims.
preUiRequiredTestsGateDesign.validationProofExpectation: Future implementation must run affected tests or fuller gates on ambiguity and must preserve planted-defect, fixture, evidence, command, provider, and environment boundaries where applicable.
